import hashlib, json
from pathlib import Path
import h5py
from scripts.ds_data02_convert import load_provenance
solver=Path('/home/jade/Projects/DualSPHysics-data/ds-data-02/families/F1/F1_REF_ECC_NOMINAL_COARSE/qualification-complete-event-001/execution-receipt.json')
gencase=Path('/home/jade/Projects/DualSPHysics-data/ds-data-02/families/F1/F1_REF_ECC_NOMINAL_COARSE/gencase-ref-ecc-coarse-v1/execution-receipt.json')
owner=Path('/home/jade/.codex/worktrees/ds-data-02-f1/DualSPHysics/lagrangian-fluid-lab/campaigns/ds-data-02/families/F1/definitions/F1_REF_ECC_NOMINAL_COARSE.metadata.json')
target=Path('/home/jade/Projects/DualSPHysics-data/ds-data-02/families/infra/F1_REF_ECC_NOMINAL_COARSE/ds02-infra-f1-bi4-conversion-v3')
h5_path=target / "trajectory.h5"
report_path=target / "conversion-report.json"
provenance=load_provenance(solver,gencase,owner)
bindings=provenance["condition_bindings"]
def digest(path):
    h=hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024*1024), b""):
            h.update(block)
    return h.hexdigest()
old_hash=digest(h5_path)
with h5py.File(h5_path,"r+") as handle:
    handle.attrs["geometry_sha256"]=bindings["geometry_sha256"]
    handle.attrs["geometry_hash_scope"]="owner metadata physical geometry and geometry_family_id; excludes resolution dp and particle mesh"
    handle.attrs["geometry_binding_json"]=json.dumps(bindings["geometry"],ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True)
    handle.attrs["control_sha256"]=bindings["control_sha256"]
    handle.attrs["control_hash_scope"]="owner solver parameters, parameter values, event window, physical initial state, and generated XML motion/execution declarations"
    handle.attrs["control_binding_json"]=json.dumps(bindings["control"],ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True)
    handle.attrs["condition_binding_missing_requirements"]=json.dumps(bindings["missing_requirements"],ensure_ascii=False)
new_hash=digest(h5_path)
report=json.loads(report_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
report["source_provenance"]["condition_bindings"]=bindings
report["output_hdf5_sha256"]=new_hash
report["output_hdf5_bytes"]=h5_path.stat().st_size
report["condition_binding_patch"]={"status":"metadata_only","old_hdf5_sha256":old_hash,"new_hdf5_sha256":new_hash,"reason":"add evaluator condition bindings from existing source provenance; trajectory datasets unchanged"}
report_path.write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps({"status":"completed","target":str(h5_path),"old_hdf5_sha256":old_hash,"new_hdf5_sha256":new_hash,"geometry_sha256":bindings["geometry_sha256"],"control_sha256":bindings["control_sha256"]},ensure_ascii=False))
request_note: Metadata-only binding patch for the already converted coarse HDF5; no solver, model, GPU, or trajectory data rewrite.
